description.value: Louie's Steakhouse is an upscale casual dining restaurant operating within The Adventure Hotel in the heart of Nelson, BC. It is a local favourite known for AAA Canadian Angus beef dry-aged 29 days, fresh seafood, and what it claims is the largest selection of wines by the glass in Nelson, with a wine cellar of over 150 bottles. Cyclists stopping in Nelson will find a full sit-down dinner experience backed by a serious bar program including the city's largest scotch, rum, and digestif collections.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 53m; bollard (2 spaces) at 62m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at adventurehotel.ca/eat-drink/louies-steakhouse/ confirms this is an active full-service restaurant within The Adventure Hotel in Nelson, BC. The site navigation includes a dedicated 'Takeout & Delivery' section confirming takeout availability, and the menu page explicitly mentions 'vegetarian options.' No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi for the restaurant specifically appears anywhere in the website content. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM lists V1L 4G2 while the website contact page shows V1L 4G1.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM lists V1L 4G2 but the website contact page shows V1L 4G1; website value used.
OSM has no phone number recorded; (250) 352-5570 was taken from the restaurant's own website page.
The direct restaurant line (250) 352-5570 differs from the hotel's main lines (1-888-722-2258 and (250) 352-7211) listed on the contact page — appears to be a dedicated restaurant number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Louie's Steakhouse is an active, well-established restaurant in central Nelson offering a full menu with vegetarian options and takeout service, making it a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists seeking a quality sit-down meal.
enrichment_extras.notes: Louie's Steakhouse is one of several food and beverage outlets operated by The Adventure Hotel; the hotel itself offers accommodation (rooms, sauna, rooftop patio, workout room) and may warrant a separate WWC lodging listing.
